the development of a novel depot system, which may have potential applications in the treatment of chronic diseases.
the preparation of a new type of long-acting depot system, which is suitable for the delivery of hydrophilic protein or polypeptide drugs.
the preparation and characterization of a novel long-acting depot-gel-in-microspheres-in-matrix-gel delivery system for the sustained release of hydrophilic drugs, such as proteins and polypeptides.
